name: Directive 11-Kappa
description: Investigate the Array's hidden substrate extraction operation. The evidence you gather — and who you share it with — will shape the path ahead.

meridian_7_intel.label: Get Coordinates from MERIDIAN-7
meridian_7_intel.description: MERIDIAN-7 mentioned resource allocation patterns that don't match any known directive. Return to the Array Hub and press for details.

infiltrate_outpost.label: Infiltrate the Extraction Outpost
infiltrate_outpost.description: Follow MERIDIAN-7's coordinates to the Array Substrate Extraction Outpost on the Ring border. Find out what Directive 11-Kappa looks like in practice.

defeat_extraction_overseer.label: Defeat the Extraction Overseer
defeat_extraction_overseer.description: The outpost's guardian must be neutralized before you can access the secured evidence terminals.

collect_evidence.label: Collect the Kappa Evidence
collect_evidence.description: Search the outpost for the three pieces of evidence: network topology data, symbiosis research, and command override protocols.

deliver_evidence.label: Deliver the Evidence
deliver_evidence.description: Three people need this intelligence. Sable can use the network data to plan a shutdown. Asha can use the symbiosis research to prove cooperation works. MERIDIAN-7 can use the command protocols to seize internal control. Choose wisely — this shapes your path.
